key_insight: TATVA reframes quantum circuit synthesis as a sequential reinforcement learning problem, using RL agents to build high-fidelity circuits gate by gate.
engineering_relevance: It offers an automated path to compact, high-accuracy quantum state preparation, which is critical for practical quantum algorithms and scalable circuit design.
method: Two RL agents, DQN and PPO, propose gates one step at a time.
After each gate, the system evaluates fidelity using Qiskit's statevector simulator and selects the best-performing circuit.
A post-hoc optimization stage reduces circuit depth while preserving fidelity.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports synthesis for up to 5 qubits with fidelity reaching 0.999999, and evaluation includes unseen target states plus metrics such as success rate, gate count, and circuit depth.
watch_item: Results are based on statevector simulation, so performance may not directly transfer to noisy hardware or larger qubit counts without further validation.
paper_title: TATVA: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Quantum Circuit Synthesis
